foot.about: Shared from Touchdown, a log of flights and aircraft. Read only, and as it is now in its owner's log.
foot.credits: Airports: OurAirports (public domain) and airportsdata (MIT). Airlines: Wikidata (CC0) and the Mictronics aircraft database (ODC-By). Names in other languages: Wikidata (CC0). Aircraft facts: the OpenSky Network aircraft database and adsbdb (data from PlaneBase). Map: Natural Earth (public domain) via world-atlas. Aircraft photos from <link>planespotters.net</link>, credited on each photo. Icons: Lucide (ISC). Typefaces: Source Sans 3 and, for Chinese, Source Han Sans as Noto Sans SC and TC (SIL Open Font License).
